_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-Gil.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

ComeBackLater.japanese: …何か 見せたいものが ある時に 戻ってきなされ。
ComeBackLater.english: ...Come back when you have something you want to show me.
